title: 第二十六章 伊士曼王国第二十七章 四叶领的异常
content_zh:
四叶城有别于绝大多数主城。平民的街道和集市并非依城堡而建，将领主及其家族居住地簇拥在中心，特蕾西把她的威金斯家族放在城外的霜叶堡，由疾影军团守卫，以避免人际混杂的城市干扰她的老家。这种措施在平日里给拜访者增添了不少麻烦，但公爵非常坚持，她宁愿在四叶城中建立处理公务的塔楼和庄园，也决不在城里过夜。
此等设计的缘由和穿梭站有关，效仿了神秘支点——这个属于里世界独有的非凡的领域。
如果你很快接受了神秘的存在，就不该感到诧异。当没有特别能力的凡人还在依靠双腿奔跑时，已经有人能眨眼飞过半个城区；在人们为了寻找平川和水源建立聚集的城市，为肥沃土地的所有争执不休、彼此仇视时，已经有人将主意打到了脑袋顶上的天穹。
事实上，后者的诞生远远早于伊士曼王国。我们的苍穹之塔克洛伊，神秘领域七支点之一，以监测诺克斯神秘之地和秩序存续为己任的占星师们，已安分守己地在所有人头顶上住了三千年。他们的后代创造出云层上的繁荣国度，并把这些奇迹般的建筑视之为理所当然。
假如他们一直这么安分守己，凡人将他们当成诸神后裔或许不是幻想。可惜神秘领域足有七个支点，神秘生物的存在就像刮风下雨一样普遍！既然有人乐意生活在云上，就会有人在重力作用下依赖大地，甚至藏在地底，尤其是后者，但只有当某天你找到了一个名为『灰烬圣殿』的与世隔绝的神秘支点，才会发现这回事：他们的与世隔绝不是没有原因的。
距离使得诺克斯各自为政。
但若你以为，距离能阻隔神秘生物对未知之地的好奇心，那着实有点儿不太现实。因此，就像占星师先祖在云上建立城市一样，神秘生物理所当然地规划自身，把特别能力应用在生活的方方面面。当计划开始落实，世界上的一切奇迹就这么诞生了。
人们的生活被“矩梯”——这么个由复杂图案和魔法符文组成，实现神秘意义上的“爬楼梯”的魔法——彻底改变。通过矩梯，你最多能爬到星星上……只要星星有出口的话。
矩梯的出口就是穿梭站。
然而，虽然人们的住所扩张已经到天空，有限土地不成问题，但并不意味着他们没得争了。诺克斯的神秘领域在获得和平前，早通过战争将他们用神秘创造出来的玩意儿传到了凡人手上。这些东西包括炼金造物、神秘物品、职业传承、神秘度决定的地位制、该死的魔药、属国分配管理方案、诸神由来的猜测和猎魔学说……以及矩梯与穿梭站。
考虑到矩梯的战略意义，特蕾西把穿梭站安排在霜叶堡附近，由疾影军团守卫的行为不难理解。事实证明，当四叶城被亡灵的袭击搞得措手不及、四处起火时，霜叶堡保存的有生力量就是整座城市的唯一救星……
……起码尤利尔这么认为。
霜叶堡是公爵的住处，此前学徒从未去过。里表世界有差别，城堡的位置会不会改变？他只能希望不会。
尤利尔已经穿过了松比格勒大街。一路上，他遇到的食尸者似乎没想象中有威胁。亡灵不会在路边游荡，它们躲藏在角落，在活人路过时才会跳出来袭击。得承认，单凭嗜血的本能没法做到这种程度，或许死人仍有意识……只是这点微末意识还需要时间成长。
『亡灵的火种来自身躯』指环先生临别时警告，『别将它们视作木头，最好当成虚弱的野狗，越快解决，你才越安全。这些东西的威胁性取决于数量』
“我不清楚四叶城有多少人……？”
“盖亚教堂没人。”使者告诉他。
如今尤利尔已经来到了教堂。守卫不见踪影，他得以走进正殿，看到死在喷泉边的黑袍人和冻结的碎块。盖亚女神的塑像和表世界同样端庄，祂的裙摆微微翘起，积蓄着融化的雪水。难怪使者认定这里很安全。学徒能感受到特别的痕迹，它们驱逐自然魔力，汇聚寒冷粒子，带给所有靠近的人一种深入火种的威慑。炎之月的热浪徘徊在大门外，与这里保持距离。
尤利尔停下来休息。他口干舌燥，肌肉酸痛，然而魔力正受火种操纵，缓慢填补他的体力。这教他无法再有理由呆在教堂，当他出门时，又有亡灵朝他扑过来。
“我知道你们为什么这么着急。”学徒低语。他挥剑斩断它的手臂，褐色血液流下剑刃，缓缓凝固。“除了我，你们很久没见到活人了，是吗？”剑尖在地面敲了敲，深色冰霜簌簌掉落。

尸体扭过肩，企图咬他的脸。
尤利尔先切四肢，再砍脑袋。剑刃锋利得超出想象。他有片刻怀疑，食尸者生前可能不是人类，而是黄油或面包这类东西。切肉不会这么容易。
“安息，神父。”
他逐渐习惯了手感。当尸体安静下来，它的同伴又涌上前。学徒将魔力推入武器，冰霜散发微光，长街似乎亮起了灯。光芒一闪而逝，消失在道路的另一端。魔力之剑破坏了所有障碍，亡灵的嘶吼戛然而止，只有断裂的肢体还在泥泞中爬动。
在魔力恢复跟不上消耗前，尤利尔穿过了城门。和教堂同样，这儿的守卫也不见踪影，但学徒瞧见血迹和凌乱的杂物，它们昭示着曾发生在这里的战斗。巡逻骑士呢？他想知道。城卫队和治安巡警呢？无人回应。使者认定他们全军覆没，学徒只能独自期望。我必须尽快通知领主。我还能怎么办呢？
城郊没有亡灵干扰。很快，霜叶堡的火红旗帜遥遥在望。
……
“你知道在朝堂上，什么人最令人反感吗？”
“嚣张无礼、狂妄自大的人？”
特蕾西审视她的侄子。“看来你很关心王国会议。”
德威特·赫恩站在她身后，在她的目光下努力直起腰。他穿深蓝外套，雪白衬衫，边缘用金丝绘出海浪般的曲线。他的披风饰以挂链，从胸前系到肩膀，衣袖和领子开口打着银钉。就衣着品味来说，他远比梅塞托里公爵好得多。
但在其他地方，此人远远不如。赫恩子爵看上去大概十五六岁，下巴光秃，眉毛细长。他的头发整齐地卷在头顶，有意露出额头和眼睛。他有灰绿色瞳孔，鼻子和眉心处的皮肤非常滑腻，犹如鱼腹。在伊士曼人眼中，它们虽然不丑，却有着极其明显的异族特征。年轻气盛的小鬼。在同龄人和长辈眼中，袒露自己和他人的差别是很有勇气的行为，然而落在王国贵族眼里，这一出只能起到反效果。人们会记得你的出身和地位，不会在乎勇气。
特蕾西懒得批评他。德威特不喜欢说教，无论是谁。马会怕鞭子。她也会利用这点来打击他，但很清楚他听不进真正的建议。说实在话，他和他哥哥相去甚远，没可能得到王党的支持。
content_en:
Yotsuba City is different from most major cities. The streets and markets of the common people were not built around the castle, but clustered the residences of the lords and their families in the center. Tracy placed her Wiggins family in Frostleaf Castle outside the city, guarded by the Swift Shadow Legion, to prevent the mixed city from interfering with her hometown. This measure caused a lot of trouble for visitors on weekdays, but the Duke was very insistent. She would rather build a tower and manor to handle official business in Four Leaf City than spend the night in the city.
The reason for this design is related to the shuttle station, imitating the mysterious pivot - this extraordinary area unique to the other world.
If you quickly accepted the existence of mystery, you shouldn't be surprised. When mortals without special abilities were still running on their legs, there were already people who could fly across half of the city in the blink of an eye; when people were building gathering cities in search of plains and water sources, arguing and hating each other for all the fertile land, there were already people who had their thoughts reaching the sky above their heads.
In fact, the latter was born long before the Eastman Kingdom. Our Lord of the Sky, Croy, is one of the seven fulcrums of the mysterious realm. The astrologers whose mission is to monitor the mysterious place of Knox and the survival of order have lived peacefully above everyone's heads for three thousand years. Their descendants created prosperous kingdoms above the clouds and took these miraculous structures for granted.
If they had always been so peaceful, it might not be an illusion for mortals to regard them as descendants of gods. Unfortunately, there are seven fulcrums in the mysterious realm, and the existence of mysterious creatures is as common as wind and rain! Since some people are happy to live on the clouds, there will be others who rely on the earth under the influence of gravity, or even hide underground, especially the latter. But only when you find an isolated mysterious fulcrum called the "Ashes Temple" one day, you will discover this: their isolation is not without reason.
Distance kept Knox separate.
But if you think that distance can stop mysterious creatures from being curious about unknown places, that’s a bit unrealistic. Therefore, just as the astrologer ancestors built cities on the clouds, the mysterious creatures naturally planned themselves and applied their special abilities to all aspects of life. When the plan started to be implemented, all the miracles in the world were born.
People's lives have been completely changed by the "Ritual Ladder" - a magic that is composed of complex patterns and magic runes to achieve "climbing stairs" in a mysterious sense. Through the ladder, you can climb up to the stars... as long as the stars have an exit.
The exit of the staircase is the shuttle station.
However, although people's residences have expanded to the sky and limited land is no problem, it does not mean that they have nothing to fight for. Before the mysterious realm of Knox gained peace, the gadgets they created with mystery were passed on to mortal hands through war. These things include alchemical creations, mysterious items, professional inheritance, status systems determined by mystery, damn magic potions, vassal distribution management plans, speculations on the origin of gods and demon hunting doctrines... as well as rectangular ladders and shuttle stations.
Considering the strategic significance of the Moment Ladder, Tracy arranged the shuttle station near Frostleaf Castle, and it is not difficult to understand her behavior of being guarded by the Swift Shadow Legion. Facts have proved that when Four Leaf City was caught off guard by the undead attack and burst into flames everywhere, the remaining vitality of Frostleaf Castle was the only savior of the entire city...
...At least Uriel thinks so.
Frostleaf Castle is the Duke's residence and has never been visited by apprentices before. If there is a difference between the inside and outside world, will the location of the castle change? He could only hope not.
Uriel had already crossed Sombigrad Street. Along the way, the corpse-eaters he encounters seem less threatening than he imagined. The undead don't wander around the roadside. They hide in corners and only jump out to attack living people passing by. I have to admit that bloodthirsty instinct alone cannot achieve this level. Maybe the dead are still conscious... but that's it.The subtle consciousness still needs time to grow.
"The fire of the undead comes from the body," Mr. Ring warned before leaving, "Don't treat them as wood, it's better to treat them as weak wild dogs. The sooner you deal with them, the safer you will be." The threat of these things depends on the quantity.』
"I don't know how many people there are in Yotsuba Castle...?"
"There is no one in Gaia's church," the messenger told him.
Now Uriel has arrived at the church. The guard was nowhere to be seen, and he was able to walk into the main hall and see the dead man in black robes and the frozen fragments beside the fountain. The statue of the goddess Gaia is as dignified as the outside world. Her skirt is slightly raised, collecting melted snow water. No wonder the messenger thought it was safe here. Apprentices can feel special traces. They expel natural magic, gather cold particles, and bring a threat of deep fire to all those who come close. The heat wave of the flaming moon lingers outside the gate, keeping a distance from this place.
Uriel stopped to rest. His mouth was dry and his muscles were sore, but the magic power was being controlled by the fire, slowly replenishing his physical strength. This gave him no reason to stay in the church. When he went out, another undead pounced on him.
"I know why you are so anxious," the apprentice whispered. He swung his sword to cut off its arm, and brown blood flowed down the blade and slowly solidified. "Except for me, you haven't seen a living person for a long time, right?" The tip of the sword knocked on the ground, and dark frost fell.
The corpse twisted its shoulders and tried to bite his face.
Uriel cut off the limbs first, then the head. The blade is sharper than you can imagine. He suspected for a moment that the corpse-eaters might not have been human in life, but something like butter or bread. Cutting meat won't be that easy.
"RIP, Father."
He gradually got used to the feel. When the body fell silent, its companions rushed forward. The apprentice pushed magic into the weapon, the frost shimmered, and the long street seemed to light up. The light flashed and disappeared at the other end of the road. The magic sword destroyed all obstacles, and the roar of the undead suddenly stopped. Only the broken limbs were still crawling in the mud.
Before the recovery of magic power could keep up with the consumption, Uriel passed through the city gate. Like the church, there were no guards here, but the apprentice saw blood stains and messy debris, which indicated the battle that had taken place here. What about the patrol knights? he wanted to know. What about the city guard and the security patrol? No one responded. The envoy believed that they were all wiped out, and the apprentice could only hope alone. I must inform the lord as soon as possible. What else could I do?
There are no undead disturbances on the outskirts of the city. Soon, the flaming red flag of Frostleaf Castle was visible in the distance.
…
"Do you know who is the most disgusting person in the court?"
"An arrogant, arrogant person?"
Tracy studied her nephew. "It seems you care about the Kingdom Council."
DeWitt Hearn stood behind her, trying to straighten up under her gaze. He wears a dark blue coat and a snow-white shirt, with gold threads on the edges to draw wave-like curves. His cloak is decorated with chains that fasten from his chest to his shoulders, and his sleeves and collar openings are studded with silver nails. In terms of dress sense, he was far better than Duke Messettori.
But in other places, this person is far inferior. Viscount Herne looked to be about fifteen or sixteen years old, with a bald chin and slender eyebrows. His hair is neatly curled on top of his head, intentionally exposing his forehead and eyes. He has gray-green pupils, and the skin on his nose and between his eyebrows is very smooth, like the belly of a fish. In the eyes of the Eastman people, although they are not ugly, they have extremely obvious alien characteristics. Young and energetic kid. In the eyes of peers and elders, exposing the differences between oneself and others is a very courageous act. However, in the eyes of the nobles of the kingdom, this can only have the opposite effect. People will remember your origin and status, not your courage.
Tracy didn't bother criticizing him. DeWitt didn't like preaching, no matter who it was. Horses can be afraid of whips. She would also use this against him, but it was clear that he was incapable of taking real advice. To be honest, he andHis brother is far away from him and is unlikely to get the support of the royal party.
